verses.en: The burden of Tyre. Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.
verses.pt: Revelação sobre Tiro:Uivai, navios de Társis, pois ela está arruinada, sem sobrar casa alguma, nem entrada nela. Desde a terra do Chipre isto lhes foi informado.
verses.en_web: The burden of Tyre. Howl, you ships of Tarshish! For it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in. From the land of Kittim it is revealed to them.
verses.en_bbe: The word about Tyre. Let a cry of sorrow go up, O ships of Tarshish, because your strong place is made waste; on the way back from the land of Kittim the news is given to them.

verses.en: Be still, ye inhabitants of the isle; thou whom the merchants of Zidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.
verses.pt: Calai-vos, moradores do litoral; vós mercadores de Sidom, que vos enchíeis pelos que atravessavam o mar.
verses.en_web: Be still, you inhabitants of the coast, you whom the merchants of Sidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.
verses.en_bbe: Send out a cry of grief, you men of the sea-land, traders of Zidon, who go over the sea, whose representatives are on great waters;

verses.en: And by great waters the seed of Sihor, the harvest of the river, is her revenue; and she is a mart of nations.
verses.pt: E sua renda era os grãos de Sior, a colheita do Nilo, que vinha por muitas águas. Ela era o centro de comércio das nações.
verses.en_web: On great waters, the seed of the Shihor, the harvest of the Nile, was her revenue. She was the market of nations.
verses.en_bbe: Who get in the seed of Shihor, whose wealth is the trade of the nations.

verses.en: Be thou ashamed, O Zidon: for the sea hath spoken, even the strength of the sea, saying, I travail not, nor bring forth children, neither do I nourish up young men, nor bring up virgins.
verses.pt: Envergonha-te, Sidom; pois o mar falou, a fortaleza do mar disse: Eu não tive dores de parto, nem de mim nasceu criança; nunca criei meninos nem eduquei virgens.
verses.en_web: Be ashamed, Sidon; for the sea has spoken, the stronghold of the sea, saying, “I have not travailed, nor given birth, neither have I nourished young men, nor brought up virgins.”
verses.en_bbe: Be shamed, O Zidon: for the sea, the strong place of the sea has said, I have not been with child, or given birth; I have not taken care of young men, or kept watch over the growth of virgins.

verses.en: As at the report concerning Egypt, so shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.
verses.pt: Quando as notícias chegarem ao Egito, eles se angustiarão com as informações de Tiro.
verses.en_web: When the report comes to Egypt, they will be in anguish at the report of Tyre.
verses.en_bbe: When the news comes to Egypt they will be bitterly pained at the fate of Tyre.

verses.en: Pass ye over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the isle.
verses.pt: Passai-vos a Társis; uivai, moradores do litoral!
verses.en_web: Pass over to Tarshish! Wail, you inhabitants of the coast!
verses.en_bbe: Go over to Tarshish; give cries of sorrow, O men of the sea-land.

verses.en: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days? her own feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn.
verses.pt: É esta a vossa alegre cidade? A que existia desde os tempos antigos? Eram os pés dela que a levavam para alcançar lugares distantes?
verses.en_web: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days, whose feet carried her far away to travel?
verses.en_bbe: Is this the town which was full of joy, whose start goes back to times long past, whose wanderings took her into far-off countries?

verses.en: Who hath taken this counsel against Tyre, the crowning city, whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honourable of the earth?
verses.pt: Quem foi, pois, que determinou isto contra Tiro, a que dava coroas, que cujos mercadores eram príncipes, e cujos comerciantes eram os mais ilustres da terra?
verses.en_web: Who has planned this against Tyre, the giver of crowns, whose merchants are princes, whose traders are the honorable of the earth?
verses.en_bbe: By whom was this purposed against Tyre, the crowning town, whose traders are chiefs, whose business men are honoured in the land?

verses.en: The LORD of hosts hath purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, and to bring into contempt all the honourable of the earth.
verses.pt: Foi o SENHOR dos exércitos que determinou isto, para envergonhar o orgulho de sua beleza, e humilhar a todos os ilustres da terra.
verses.en_web: Yahweh of Armies has planned it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.
verses.en_bbe: It was the purpose of the Lord of armies to put pride to shame, to make sport of the glory of those who are honoured in the earth.

verses.en: Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish: there is no more strength.
verses.pt: Passa-te como o rio à tua terra, ó filha de Társis, pois já não há mais fortaleza.
verses.en_web: Pass through your land like the Nile, daughter of Tarshish. There is no restraint any more.
verses.en_bbe: Let your land be worked with the plough, O daughter of Tarshish; there is no longer any harbour.

verses.en: He stretched out his hand over the sea, he shook the kingdoms: the LORD hath given a commandment against the merchant city, to destroy the strong holds thereof.
verses.pt: Ele estendeu sua mão sobre o mar, e abalou aos reinos; o SENHOR deu uma ordem contra Canaã, para destruir suas fortalezas.
verses.en_web: He has stretched out his hand over the sea. He has shaken the kingdoms. Yahweh has ordered the destruction of Canaan’s strongholds.
verses.en_bbe: His hand is stretched out over the sea, the kingdoms are shaking: the Lord has given orders about Canaan, to make waste its strong places.

verses.en: And he said, Thou shalt no more rejoice, O thou oppressed virgin, daughter of Zidon: arise, pass over to Chittim; there also shalt thou have no rest.
verses.pt: E disse: Nunca mais te encherás de alegria, ó oprimida virgem, filha de Sidom; levanta-te, passa ao Chipre; e alinda ali não terás descanso.
verses.en_web: He said, “You shall rejoice no more, you oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, pass over to Kittim. Even there you will have no rest.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, There is no more joy for you, O crushed virgin daughter of Zidon: up! go over to Kittim; even there you will have no rest.

verses.en: Behold the land of the Chaldeans; this people was not, til the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness: they set up the towers thereof, they raised up the palaces thereof; and he brought it to ruin.
verses.pt: Olhai para a terra dos Caldeus, este que deixou de ser povo. A Assíria a fundou para os que moravam no deserto; levantaram suas fortalezas, e derrubaram seus palácios; transformou-a em ruínas.
verses.en_web: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans. This people was not. The Assyrians founded it for those who dwell in the wilderness. They set up their towers. They overthrew its palaces. They made it a ruin.

verses.en: Howl, ye ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.
verses.pt: Uivai, navios de Társis; porque destruída está vossa fortaleza.
verses.en_web: Howl, you ships of Tarshish, for your stronghold is laid waste!
verses.en_bbe: Let a cry of sorrow go up, O ships of Tarshish: because your strong place is made waste.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot.
verses.pt: E será naquele dia, que Tiro será esquecida por setenta anos, como dias de um rei; mas ao fim de setenta anos, haverá em Tiro algo como a canção da prostituta:
verses.en_web: It will come to pass in that day that Tyre will be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king. After the end of seventy years it will be to Tyre like in the song of the prostitute.
verses.en_bbe: And it will be in that day that Tyre will go out of mind for seventy years, that is, the days of one king: after the end of seventy years it will be for Tyre as in the song of the loose woman.

verses.en: Take an harp, go about the city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.
verses.pt: Toma uma harpa, rodeia a cidade, ó prostituta esquecida; toca boa música, e canta várias canções, para que tu sejas lembrada.
verses.en_web: Take a harp; go about the city, you prostitute that has been forgotten. Make sweet melody. Sing many songs, that you may be remembered.
verses.en_bbe: Take an instrument of music, go about the town, O loose woman who has gone out from the memory of man; make sweet melody with songs, so that you may come back to men's minds.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that the LORD will visit Tyre, and she shall turn to her hire, and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.
verses.pt: Pois será que, ao fim de setenta anos, o SENHOR visitará a Tiro, e voltará à sua atividade, prostituindo-se com todos os reinos do mundo que há sobre a face da terra.
verses.en_web: It will happen after the end of seventy years that Yahweh will visit Tyre, and she shall return to her wages, and will play the prostitute with all the kingdoms of the world on the surface of the earth.
verses.en_bbe: And it will be after the end of seventy years, that the Lord will have mercy on Tyre, and she will go back to her trade, acting as a loose woman with all the kingdoms of the world on the face of the earth.

verses.en: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the LORD: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
verses.pt: Mas seu comércio e seus ganhos como prostituta serão consagrados ao SENHOR; não serão guardados nem depositados; mas seu comércio será para os que habitam perante o SENHOR, para que comam até se saciarem, e tenham roupas de boa qualidade.
verses.en_web: Her merchandise and her wages will be holiness to Yahweh. It will not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise will be for those who dwell before Yahweh, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
verses.en_bbe: And her goods and her trade will be holy to the Lord: they will not be kept back or stored up; for her produce will be for those living in the Lord's land, to give them food for their needs, and fair clothing.
